committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 18 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Weekly ad spend is A$137.58 across 23 clicks at a A$5.98 CPC, down slightly from A$144.06 on the same 23 clicks last week; CTR improved to 2.6% from 2.2% but conversions last7 are still zero.

30-day impression share is only 10%, with 73% lost to rank and 21.5% lost to budget; no external Google Ads account changes were logged in the last 24 hours or last 7 days, so this reading is not contaminated.

Since the landing page test started 6 Oct, raw totalPaidClicks sit at 40 with 10 ask_cta_click events and zero review_cta_click or generate_lead events recorded; past 25 clicks the page copy and CTAs stay frozen unless something breaks.
AI Assistant sessions fell to 1 last7 from 4 prior7, still led by chatgpt.com; this channel undercounts since many AI referrals arrive with no referrer and land in Direct instead.

actions.text: Raw totalPaidClicks has passed 25 (now 40): the page headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen unless something breaks.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding and need supplying.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to match current site stats.
